FileSystemManager.readFile(Object object)

Read the file(Minimum version: 23.6.0).

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
filePath String Yes Path of the file to be read. (Local path. The usr directory can be a relative directory, but the final real path cannot be outside the usr directory. Temporary path and cache path files can be read.)
encoding String No Character encoding of the file to be read. If encoding is not transferred, the binary content of the file is read in the ArrayBuffer format.
position Number No Read data from the specified position in the file. If this parameter is not specified, read data from the file header. The read range should be left closed and right open interval [position, position+length). Valid range: [0, fileLength - 1]. Unit: byte
length Number No Specifies the length of the file, if not specified, read to the end of the document. Scope of validity:[1, fileLength]. Unit: byte
success Function No Callback function that is successfully invoked.
fail Function No Callback function that fails to be invoked.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)
encoding
Valid Value Description
ascii
base64 Note that if Base64 encoding is selected, only the Base64 content needs to be transferred for data. Do not transfer the Data URl prefix. Otherwise, the fail base64 encode error message is displayed. For example, pass aGVsbG8= instead of data:image/png;base64,aGVsbG8=
ucs2 Read in little-endian order
ucs-2 Read in little-endian order
utf16le Read in little-endian order
utf-16le Read in little-endian order
utf-8
utf8 Default value
latin1
success callback function
Object res
Attribute Type Description
data String/ArrayBuffer File content (If encoding is not transferred, ArrayBuffer is returned.)

Sample Code

let fs = ma.getFileSystemManager();

fs.readFile({
  filePath:  `${ma.env.USER_DATA_PATH}/testFile.txt`,
  encoding: 'utf8',
  success: res => {
    console.log(res);
  },
  fail(err) {
    console.log(err);
  }
});

Tips

  1. The size of the read file is limited to 10 MB.
